name: tags-input
title: Tags Input
description: Tag chips input: type and press Enter to add, Backspace to delete the last tag, double-click a tag to edit it inline, with an optional max tag count and paste splitting.

props.name: addOnPaste
props.description: Whether to add a tag when you paste values into the tag input

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Whether to allow duplicate tags.

props.name: allowOverflow
props.description:
Whether to allow tags to exceed max. In this case,
we'll attach `data-invalid` to the root

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the input should be auto-focused

props.name: blurBehavior
props.description:
The behavior of the tags input when the input is blurred
- `"add"`: add the input value as a new tag
- `"clear"`: clear the input value

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description:
The initial tag input value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the tag input value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial tag value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the tag value.

props.name: delimiter
props.description:
The character that serves has:
- event key to trigger the addition of a new tag
- character used to split tags when pasting into the input

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tags input should be disabled

props.name: editable
props.description: Whether a tag can be edited after creation, by pressing `Enter` or double clicking.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tags input. Useful for composition.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The controlled tag input's value

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the tags input is invalid

props.name: max
props.description: The max number of tags

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The max length of the input.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute for the input. Useful for form submissions

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text for the input

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the tags input should be read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the tags input is required

props.name: sanitizeValue
props.description:
Function to sanitize the tag value before adding.
Useful for trimming whitespace, normalizing case, or stripping special characters.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: validate
props.description:
Returns a boolean that determines whether a tag can be added.
Useful for preventing duplicates or invalid tag values.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled tag value

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onHighlightChange
events.description: Callback fired when a tag is highlighted by pointer or keyboard navigation

events.name: onInputValueChange
events.description: Callback fired when the input value is updated

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Callback fired when the tag values is updated

events.name: onValueInvalid
events.description: Callback fired when the max tag count is reached or the `validateTag` function returns `false`

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";

<TagsInput defaultValue=["shadcn", "marko", "zag-js"] placeholder="Add tag..." class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: An uncontrolled tags input seeded with `defaultValue`.

examples.title: With label
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";

<TagsInput label="Skills" defaultValue=["typescript"] placeholder="Add a skill..." class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: Pass `label` to render an associated `<label>` above the control.

examples.title: Max tags
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";

<TagsInput defaultValue=["one", "two"] max=3 placeholder="Add tag..." class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: Set `max` to cap how many tags can be added.

examples.title: Paste splitting
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";

<TagsInput addOnPaste defaultValue=[] placeholder="Paste a comma-separated list..." class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: Set `addOnPaste` to split a comma-separated clipboard paste into individual tags.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";

<TagsInput defaultValue=["locked", "read-only"] disabled placeholder="Add tag..." class="w-[320px]"/>
examples.description: A disabled tags input ignores pointer and keyboard input.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import TagsInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tags-input/tags-input.marko";
Value: ${value.join(", ")}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.
